WITH "district_schools" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "f"."County Name", "f"."District Name", "f".cdscode, "s".admfname1, "s".admfname2, "s".admfname3 FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."County Name" IN ('Amador', 'Madera') AND "f"."District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')), "listed_names" AS (SELECT cdscode, admfname1 AS "first_name" FROM "district_schools" WHERE admfname1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT cdscode, admfname2 AS "first_name" FROM "district_schools" WHERE admfname2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT cdscode, admfname3 AS "first_name" FROM "district_schools" WHERE admfname3 IS NOT NULL), "top_names" AS (SELECT first_name FROM "listed_names" GROUP BY first_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) DESC, first_name ASC LIMIT 2), "districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "County Name", "District Name" FROM "district_schools"), "counts" AS (SELECT "ds"."County Name", "ds"."District Name", "ln".first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "ln".cdscode) AS "school_count" FROM "district_schools" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "listed_names" AS "ln" ON "ln".cdscode = "ds".cdscode GROUP BY "ds"."County Name", "ds"."District Name", "ln".first_name) SELECT "d"."District Name", "n".first_name, COALESCE("c".school_count, 0) AS "school_count" FROM "districts" AS "d" CROSS JOIN "top_names" AS "n" LEFT JOIN "counts" AS "c" ON "c"."County Name" = "d"."County Name" AND "c"."District Name" = "d"."District Name" AND "c".first_name = "n".first_name ORDER BY "d"."District Name" ASC, "n".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("f"."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_eligible_students" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".soctype = 'Youth Authority Facilities' LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."School Name", "s".eilname FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "f".cdscode = '01612590136051' AND "f"."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' LIMIT 501

SELECT "sc".school AS "school_name", "sc".admemail1 AS "administrator_email" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc" ON "sc".cdscode = "f".cdscode INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sa" ON "sa".cds = "sc".cdscode WHERE "f"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "sa".rtype = 'S' AND "sa".numge1500 IS NOT NULL AND "sa".numge1500 = (SELECT MAX("sa2".numge1500) FROM "frpm" AS "f2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "sc2" ON "sc2".cdscode = "f2".cdscode INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sa2" ON "sa2".cds = "sc2".cdscode WHERE "f2"."District Type" = 'State Board of Education' AND "sa2".rtype = 'S' AND "sa2".numge1500 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("ss".numtsttakr, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_sat_test_takers_per_school" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "ss" ON "ss".cds = "s".cdscode LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Los Angeles' AND "s".opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01' AND "s".opendate < DATE '2008-01-01' AND "f"."District Type" IN ('County Office of Education', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') LIMIT 501

SELECT "frpm"."Charter Funding Type" AS "funding_category", COUNT(*) AS "active_charter_school_count", SUM("frpm"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_2014_2015_k12_enrollment", ROUND(AVG("frpm"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"::NUMERIC * 100), 2) AS "avg_k12_frpm_eligible_percentage", ROUND(AVG("sat".combined_sat_score), 2) AS "avg_combined_sat_score" FROM "frpm" INNER JOIN "schools" ON "frpm".cdscode = "schools".cdscode LEFT JOIN (SELECT cds, AVG((avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite)::NUMERIC) AS "combined_sat_score" FROM "satscores" WHERE rtype = 'S' AND avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cds) AS "sat" ON "frpm".cdscode = "sat".cds WHERE "frpm"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "frpm"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "frpm"."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') AND "schools".statustype = 'Active' AND "frpm"."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND "frpm"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "frpm"."Charter Funding Type" LIMIT 501

WITH "candidates" AS (SELECT "f"."School Name" AS "school_name", "f"."Low Grade" AS "low_grade", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "enrollment_k12", "f".cdscode, CASE "f"."Low Grade" WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1 WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 4 WHEN '4' THEN 5 WHEN '5' THEN 6 WHEN '6' THEN 7 WHEN '7' THEN 8 WHEN '8' THEN 9 WHEN '9' THEN 10 WHEN '10' THEN 11 WHEN '11' THEN 12 WHEN '12' THEN 13 END AS "grade_order" FROM "frpm" AS "f" WHERE "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' AND "f"."District Type" = 'State Special Schools'), "test_takers" AS (SELECT cds, SUM(numtsttakr) AS "sat_test_takers" FROM "satscores" WHERE rtype = 'S' GROUP BY cds) SELECT "c".school_name, "c".low_grade AS "earliest_grade_level", "c".enrollment_k12, COALESCE("t".sat_test_takers, 0) AS "sat_test_takers" FROM "candidates" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "test_takers" AS "t" ON "t".cds = "c".cdscode WHERE "c".grade_order IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "c".grade_order DESC, "c".enrollment_k12 DESC NULLS LAST, "c".school_name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."High Grade" ~ '^[1-8]$' AND "s".school IS NOT NULL AND "s".school <> '' AND "s".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".doc <> '00' AND COALESCE("sat".numtsttakr, 0) = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "Charter Funding Type", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE statustype = 'Active') AS "currently_operating_schools", SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_k12_enrollment", SUM("FRPM Count (K-12)") AS "total_frpm_eligible_k12_students" FROM "frpm" INNER JOIN "schools" USING (cdscode) WHERE "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND "District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)' AND "Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') GROUP BY "Charter Funding Type" ORDER BY CASE "Charter Funding Type" WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1 WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".district, "s".county, "ss".avgscrwrite FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "ss" ON "ss".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".statustype = 'Closed' AND "ss".rtype = 'S' AND "ss".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL AND "ss".avgscrwrite = (SELECT MAX("ss2".avgscrwrite) FROM "schools" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "ss2" ON "ss2".cds = "s2".cdscode WHERE "s2".statustype = 'Closed' AND "ss2".rtype = 'S' AND "ss2".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL AND "ss2".avgscrwrite < (SELECT MAX("ss3".avgscrwrite) FROM "schools" AS "s3" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "ss3" ON "ss3".cds = "s3".cdscode WHERE "s3".statustype = 'Closed' AND "ss3".rtype = 'S' AND "ss3".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

WITH "target_county" AS (SELECT "County Code", "County Name" FROM "frpm" WHERE cdscode = '1612590125716'), "qualified_schools" AS (SELECT "f".cdscode, "tc"."County Name", "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" AS "charter", ROUND(("f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)::NUMERIC * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "free_pct", ROUND(("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)::NUMERIC * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "frpm_pct" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "target_county" AS "tc" ON "f"."County Code" = "tc"."County Code" WHERE "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700 AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0), "sat_school_scores" AS (SELECT cds, avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite AS "total_sat" FROM "satscores" WHERE rtype = 'S' AND avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL) SELECT "q"."County Name", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_schools", ROUND(AVG("q".free_pct), 2) AS "average_free_meal_percentage", ROUND(AVG("q".frpm_pct), 2) AS "average_frpm_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "q".charter = 1) AS "charter_schools", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "q".charter = 0) AS "non_charter_schools", ROUND(AVG("s".total_sat)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_sat_score" FROM "qualified_schools" AS "q" LEFT JOIN "sat_school_scores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "q".cdscode GROUP BY "q"."County Name" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / 12 AS "average_schools_per_month" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county ILIKE 'San Diego' AND "s".opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "s".opendate < DATE '1981-01-01' AND "f"."District Type" IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".virtual IN ('F', 'P')) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "satscores" AS "t" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "t".cds WHERE "t".avgscrmath > 400 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".county, "s".district, "s".city, "f"."Enrollment (K-12)", "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)", "f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", "t".numtsttakr, "t".avgscrread, "t".avgscrmath, "t".avgscrwrite, "t".numge1500 FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "t" ON "s".cdscode = "t".cds WHERE "s".cdscode = '01612590137943' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "f".cdscode, "s".school, "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS "free_meal_rate", "s".charter, "s".gsserved FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 AND "s".gsserved IS NOT NULL AND "s".gsserved ~ '(^|[^0-9])12([^0-9]|$)' AND "s".county ILIKE 'Alameda' AND "s".eilname = 'High School'), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, MAX(free_meal_rate) OVER () AS "max_rate" FROM "eligible") SELECT "r".school AS "school_name", ROUND("r".free_meal_rate::NUMERIC, 4) AS "free_meal_rate", CASE WHEN "r".charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "r".charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "charter_school", "r".gsserved AS "grades_served", CASE WHEN "sat".cds IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "sat_performance_level" FROM "ranked" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "r".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "r".free_meal_rate = "r".max_rate LIMIT 501

SELECT "sc".school, "sc".phone, "sc".website, "sat".avgscrread, "sat".avgscrmath, "sat".avgscrwrite, "sc".charter, "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "enrollment_k12_2014_2015", ROUND("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percent_eligible_frpm_0_100", (SELECT MAX("s2".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s3" ON "s2".cds = "s3".cdscode WHERE "s3".statustype = 'Active' AND "s2".rtype = 'S' AND "s2".numtsttakr >= 10 AND "s2".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL) AS "highest_active_school_avg_sat_math", (SELECT MAX("s2".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s3" ON "s2".cds = "s3".cdscode WHERE "s3".statustype = 'Active' AND "s2".rtype = 'S' AND "s2".numtsttakr >= 10 AND "s2".avgscrmath IS NOT NULL) - "sat".avgscrmath AS "points_below_highest" FROM "schools" AS "sc" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "sc".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "sc".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "sc".cdscode = '07618040113118' LIMIT 501

WITH "virtual_counts" AS (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "virtual_school_count" FROM "schools" WHERE virtual = 'F' GROUP BY county), "top_counties" AS (SELECT county, virtual_school_count FROM "virtual_counts" WHERE virtual_school_count >= (SELECT virtual_school_count FROM "virtual_counts" ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4)), "ranked_scores" AS (SELECT "s".county, "s".school, "sat".avgscrread, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s".county ORDER BY "sat".avgscrread DESC) AS "score_rank" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".virtual = 'F' AND "sat".avgscrread IS NOT NULL), "best_schools" AS (SELECT county, school FROM "ranked_scores" WHERE score_rank = 1) SELECT "tc".county, "tc".virtual_school_count, COALESCE("bs".school, 'None') AS "school" FROM "top_counties" AS "tc" LEFT JOIN "best_schools" AS "bs" ON "bs".county = "tc".county ORDER BY "tc".virtual_school_count DESC, "tc".county ASC LIMIT 501

AND "ph".posthistorytypeid = 5 AND "ph".comment IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("ph".comment) <> '' GROUP BY "u".displayname HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(editor_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "editor_count" FROM "posts" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "posthistory" AS "ph2" ON "ph2".postid = "p2".id WHERE "p2".title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND "ph2".posthistorytypeid = 5 AND "ph2".comment IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("ph2".comment) <> '' GROUP BY "ph2".userid) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

WITH "customer_totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "y".customerid, SUM("y".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) >= 201301 AND CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) < 201401 GROUP BY "c".segment, "y".customerid), "chosen" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment) segment, customerid, total_consumption FROM "customer_totals" ORDER BY segment ASC, total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC) SELECT ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM "chosen" LIMIT 501

WITH "segment_totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201301) AS "total_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401) AS "total_2013" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY "c".segment), "increases" AS (SELECT segment, (total_2013 - total_2012) / total_2012 * 100 AS "increase_percentage" FROM "segment_totals" WHERE total_2012 <> 0), "extremes" AS (SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) AS "highest", MIN(increase_percentage) AS "lowest" FROM "increases") SELECT "i".segment, ROUND("i".increase_percentage::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "increases" AS "i" CROSS JOIN "extremes" AS "e" WHERE "i".increase_percentage = "e".highest OR "i".increase_percentage = "e".lowest ORDER BY "i".increase_percentage DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "annual" AS (SELECT SUM(consumption) FILTER (WHERE date::INTEGER BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212) AS "total_2012", SUM(consumption) FILTER (WHERE date::INTEGER BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS "total_2013" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 6718) SELECT ROUND(((total_2013 - total_2012) / total_2012)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "annual" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201301 THEN 2012 END) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 THEN 2013 END) > 0) AS "qualified_customers" LIMIT 501

WITH "active_2012" AS (SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE date >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND date < DATE '2013-01-01'), "consumption_2012" AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE CAST(date AS INTEGER) >= 201201 AND CAST(date AS INTEGER) < 201301 GROUP BY customerid) SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "active_2012" AS "a" INNER JOIN "consumption_2012" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "a".customerid INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "a".customerid WHERE "y".total_consumption < 30000 GROUP BY "c".segment ORDER BY "c".segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "y".customerid) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) >= 201301 AND CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) < 201401 AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("t".date + "t".time::INTERVAL) - MIN("t".date + "t".time::INTERVAL))) / 60)::BIGINT AS "elapsed_whole_minutes" FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gasstations" AS "g" ON "t".gasstationid = "g".gasstationid WHERE "g".country = 'CZE' AND "t".price > 1000 LIMIT 501

WITH "monthly" AS (SELECT "y".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" WHERE "y".date::INTEGER BETWEEN 201301 AND 201311 AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "y".customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "y".date::INTEGER) = 11) SELECT "c".currency, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "monthly" AS "m" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "m".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, ROUND(AVG("q".quarter_consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_quarter_consumption" FROM (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "quarter_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE CAST(date AS INTEGER) >= 201304 AND CAST(date AS INTEGER) < 201307 GROUP BY customerid) AS "q" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "q".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency LIMIT 501

WITH "monthly" AS (SELECT CAST("date" AS INTEGER) AS "yearmonth", SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE CAST("date" AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201201 AND 201312 GROUP BY CAST("date" AS INTEGER)), "peaks" AS (SELECT yearmonth / 100 AS "year", MAX(total_consumption) AS "peak_total" FROM "monthly" GROUP BY yearmonth / 100) SELECT ROUND(MAX(peak_total) FILTER (WHERE year = 2013) - MAX(peak_total) FILTER (WHERE year = 2012)) AS "difference" FROM "peaks" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "y".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "y".date::INTEGER BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 GROUP BY "y".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".id = "m".league_id WHERE "l".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m".season = '2009/2010' AND "m".away_team_goal > "m".home_team_goal GROUP BY "t".team_api_id, "t".team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(away_win_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "away_win_count" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "m2".league_id WHERE "l2".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m2".season = '2009/2010' AND "m2".away_team_goal > "m2".home_team_goal GROUP BY "m2".away_team_api_id) AS "win_counts") ORDER BY "t".team_long_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * ("end_balance".balance - "start_balance".balance) / NULLIF("start_balance".balance, 0) AS "percentage_increase" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date = DATE '1993-03-22' ORDER BY "t".trans_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "start_balance" ON TRUE INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date = DATE '1998-12-27' ORDER BY "t".trans_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "end_balance" ON TRUE WHERE "l".date = DATE '1993-07-05' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".frequency FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '2001-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", ROUND((("d".a13 - "d".a12) / "d".a12 * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percentage_change" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a12 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a13 IS NOT NULL AND "l".status = 'D' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a12, "d".a13 LIMIT 501

SELECT "dp".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "dp".account_id) AS "distinct_accounts" FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "account" AS "ac" ON "ac".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ac".district_id WHERE "dp".type <> 'OWNER' AND "d".a11 > 8000 AND "d".a11 <= 9000 GROUP BY "dp".type LIMIT 501

WITH "yearly_totals" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) AS "loan_year", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "l".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)) SELECT MAX(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE loan_year = 1996) AS "total_loan_amount_1996", MAX(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE loan_year = 1997) AS "total_loan_amount_1997", ((MAX(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE loan_year = 1997) - MAX(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE loan_year = 1996)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(MAX(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE loan_year = 1996), 0)) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "yearly_totals" LIMIT 501
SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

WITH "first_month" AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(date))::DATE AS "month_start" FROM "account"), "opening_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" CROSS JOIN "first_month" AS "f" WHERE "a".date >= "f".month_start AND "a".date < ("f".month_start + INTERVAL '1 month')) SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population" FROM "opening_districts" AS "o" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "o".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT = (SELECT MAX("d2".a4::BIGINT) FROM "opening_districts" AS "o2" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "o2".district_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT district_id, a2 FROM "district" ORDER BY a16 DESC LIMIT 5), "district_active_loans" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("l".amount) AS "active_loan_amount" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_account_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id) SELECT "td".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(COALESCE("dal".active_loan_amount, 0)::NUMERIC / "dac".account_count)::BIGINT AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM "top_districts" AS "td" INNER JOIN "district_account_counts" AS "dac" ON "dac".district_id = "td".district_id LEFT JOIN "district_active_loans" AS "dal" ON "dal".district_id = "td".district_id ORDER BY average_active_loan_per_account DESC, "td".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "l".amount FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration || ' months')::INTERVAL - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE >= DATE '1995-12-31'), "totals" AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY region) SELECT region, total_amount FROM "totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary), 2) AS "average_of_districts_average_salaries", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, AVG("d".a11) AS "district_avg_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "d".district_id IN (SELECT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01' GROUP BY "a".district_id) GROUP BY "d".district_id) AS "eligible_districts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "d".district_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id WHERE "account_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id)) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".account_id IN (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') LIMIT 501

WITH "branch" AS (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Prachatice'), "borrowed" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "branch" AS "b" ON "b".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "b".account_id, "b".opening_date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".counterparty_count, 0) AS "outside_counterparties", "owner_d".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "owner_d".a4 AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "owner_d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "borrowed" AS "b" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "b".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "owner" ON "owner".client_id = "od".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "owner_d" ON "owner_d".district_id = "owner".district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "b".account_id ORDER BY "owner_d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "b".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT "account_id", AVG("balance") AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY "account_id"), "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "dp"."account_id", "c"."gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp"."disp_id" = "ca"."disp_id" AND "dp"."type" = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c"."client_id" = "dp"."client_id" INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "av" ON "av"."account_id" = "dp"."account_id" AND "av".avg_balance > 1000 WHERE "ca"."type" = 'gold'), "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "qa"."gender", "d"."district_id", "d"."a4"::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d"."a12" AS "salary", "d"."a13" AS "urban_ratio" FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a"."account_id" = "qa"."account_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "a"."district_id" WHERE "d"."a4"::BIGINT > 100000), "stats" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_salary", ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_urban_ratio", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM "eligible_districts" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "e".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "e".district_id, "e".inhabitants, "s".avg_salary, "s".avg_urban_ratio FROM "eligible_districts" AS "e" INNER JOIN "stats" AS "s" ON "s".gender = "e".gender WHERE "e".inhabitants = "s".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "e".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "e".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "owner_disp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount_paid, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS "total_rank" FROM "pair_totals") SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount_paid FROM "ranked" WHERE total_rank = 1 ORDER BY bank ASC, account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM("t".amount), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a2 ILIKE 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "district_stats" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "inhabitants", "d".a11::NUMERIC AS "average_salary", "d".a12::NUMERIC AS "unemployment_1996" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "q" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "q".district_id), "region_averages" AS (SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS "avg_district_salary", ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996), 2) AS "avg_unemployment_1996" FROM "district_stats" GROUP BY region), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT district_name, region, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district_stats") SELECT "ra".region, "ra".avg_district_salary, "ra".avg_unemployment_1996, "rd".district_name AS "most_populous_district" FROM "region_averages" AS "ra" INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".region = "ra".region AND "rd".rn = 1 ORDER BY "ra".region ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "district_crimes" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", COUNT("t".trans_id) FILTER (WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01') AS "crime_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, translate(lower(district_name), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district_crimes" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia'), "top_three" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, crime_count FROM "ranked" WHERE rn <= 3), "averages" AS (SELECT (SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) FROM "top_three") AS "top_avg", (SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) FROM "district_crimes") AS "overall_avg") SELECT "t".district_name, "t".crime_count, ROUND("av".top_avg, 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND("av".overall_avg, 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND("av".top_avg - "av".overall_avg, 2) AS "difference" FROM "top_three" AS "t" CROSS JOIN "averages" AS "av" LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "d"."district_id", "d"."a2", "d"."a16" AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp"."disp_id" = "ca"."disp_id" INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl"."client_id" = "dp"."client_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "cl"."district_id"), "ranked" AS (SELECT card_type, "district_id", "a2", inhabitants, MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS "min_inhabitants" FROM "card_districts") SELECT card_type, "a2" AS "home_district", inhabitants FROM "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, "a2" ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, "a".account_id, "t".balance FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "target_region" AS "r" ON "d".a3 = "r".a3 INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "tr".balance FROM "trans" AS "tr" WHERE "tr".account_id = "a".account_id AND "tr".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "tr".date DESC, "tr".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "t" ON TRUE WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "ab".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", ROUND(AVG("ab".balance::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_balance", AVG("ab".balance::NUMERIC) AS "average_balance_sort" FROM "account_balances" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ab".district_id GROUP BY "ab".district_id, "d".a2), "overall" AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance::NUMERIC), 2) AS "region_average_balance" FROM "account_balances"), "top_district" AS (SELECT district_name FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY average_balance_sort DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "ds".district_name, "ds".accounts_opened, "ds".average_balance, "o".region_average_balance, "td".district_name AS "district_with_highest_average_balance" FROM "district_stats" AS "ds" CROSS JOIN "overall" AS "o" CROSS JOIN "top_district" AS "td" ORDER BY "ds".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "a".district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "selected_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE rn <= 10), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "selected_districts" AS "s" ON "s".district_id = "d".district_id) SELECT inhabitants AS "inhabitants", ROUND((SELECT AVG(average_salary::NUMERIC) FROM "district_stats"), 2) AS "average_salary_across_districts" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "district_accounts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "a".account_id FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000), "withdrawal_totals" AS (SELECT "da".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "district_accounts" AS "da" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "da".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "da".district_id), "standing_order_totals" AS (SELECT "da".district_id, SUM("o".amount) AS "standing_order_debit" FROM "district_accounts" AS "da" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "da".account_id GROUP BY "da".district_id), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "da".district_id, "da".district_name, "da".region, "da".population, "wt".total_withdrawn, "wt".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "da".population AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", COALESCE("sot".standing_order_debit, 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "da".account_id) AS "avg_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_accounts" AS "da" INNER JOIN "withdrawal_totals" AS "wt" ON "wt".district_id = "da".district_id LEFT JOIN "standing_order_totals" AS "sot" ON "sot".district_id = "da".district_id GROUP BY "da".district_id, "da".district_name, "da".region, "da".population, "wt".total_withdrawn, "sot".standing_order_debit) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant", ROUND(avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "avg_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_metrics" ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "home" AS (SELECT district_id FROM "client" WHERE client_id = 3541), "region_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "home_client_count" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT district_id, a3 AS "region", a2 AS "district_name", a11 AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a11 DESC) AS "population_rank", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a11 DESC, district_id ASC) AS "populous_order" FROM "district"), "transaction_stats" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date, "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "d".district_id = "h".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "d".a12 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("ts".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("ts".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rs".home_client_count AS "clients_in_region", "pd".district_name AS "most_populous_district", "pd".inhabitants AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", "rd".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "disp" AS "x" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "x".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id CROSS JOIN "home" AS "h" INNER JOIN "region_stats" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "pd" ON "pd".region = "d".a3 AND "pd".populous_order = 1 LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_stats" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "x".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "lent_amount" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER AS "opening_year", district_id, SUM(lent_amount)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), district_id) SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('year', "al".date), 'YYYY') AS "opening_year", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".lent_amount) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG("dy".lent_per_account), 2) AS "avg_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district_year" AS "dy" ON "dy".opening_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER AND "dy".district_id = "al".district_id GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('year', "al".date) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('year', "al".date) ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date AS "approval_date", "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT loan_id, account_id, amount, approval_date, district_id FROM "eligible_loans" ORDER BY amount DESC, approval_date ASC LIMIT 10), "approval_day_balance" AS (SELECT "r".loan_id, "t".balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "r".loan_id ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "ranked_loans" AS "r" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "r".account_id AND "t".date = "r".approval_date) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "r".amount AS "approved_amount", "r".approval_date, "b".balance AS "end_of_day_balance" FROM "ranked_loans" AS "r" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "r".district_id LEFT JOIN "approval_day_balance" AS "b" ON "b".loan_id = "r".loan_id AND "b".rn = 1 ORDER BY "r".amount DESC, "r".approval_date ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "issued_clients" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", "d".account_id, "di".a2 AS "district_name", "di".a11 AS "district_average_salary" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01'), "loan_totals" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id) SELECT "ic".client_id, "ic".gender, "ic".birth_date, "ic".card_type, "ic".age_at_issue, COALESCE("lt".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("lt".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("lt".loan_count, 0) > 0 AND "ic".age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN COALESCE("lt".loan_count, 0) > 0 AND "ic".age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "ic".district_name, "ic".district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "ic".gender ORDER BY "ic".age_at_issue DESC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "issued_clients" AS "ic" LEFT JOIN "loan_totals" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "ic".account_id ORDER BY "ic".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".account_id, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "population" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT district_id, district, region, population FROM "qualifying_accounts" GROUP BY district_id, district, region, population), "region_summary" AS (SELECT "q".region, COUNT(DISTINCT "q".district_id) AS "district_count", SUM("q".population) AS "combined_population", COUNT(DISTINCT "qa".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "q" INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".district_id = "q".district_id AND "qa".region = "q".region GROUP BY "q".region), "winning_region" AS (SELECT region FROM "region_summary" ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "rs".region, "rs".district_count, "rs".combined_population, "rs".account_count, "q".district FROM "region_summary" AS "rs" INNER JOIN "winning_region" AS "w" ON "w".region = "rs".region INNER JOIN "qualifying_districts" AS "q" ON "q".region = "rs".region ORDER BY "q".district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a11 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "qualifying_districts" AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01') AS "monthly_statement_accounts_opened", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG(a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "qualifying_districts" LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_amount_received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_counts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "account_metrics" AS (SELECT "ga".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lc".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ga".district_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "ga".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_counts" AS "lc" ON "lc".account_id = "ga".account_id) SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_amount_received, total_amount_withdrawn, number_of_loans, external_counterparties, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account_metrics" ORDER BY rank ASC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".client_id, "d".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "d".disp_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'classic'), "client_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS "client_count" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY district_id), "payments" AS (SELECT "e".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) AS "external_account_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "e".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "e".district_id) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COALESCE("cc".client_count, 0) AS "client_count", COALESCE("p".external_account_count, 0) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE("p".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "client_counts" AS "cc" ON "cc".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "payments" AS "p" ON "p".district_id = "d".district_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary_czk" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11::NUMERIC), 2) AS "avg_district_salary" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(((MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 853 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END) - MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 854 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 854 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END) * 100), 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r".raceid IN (853, 854) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT q2_time FROM (SELECT DISTINCT q2 AS "q2_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q2q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "q2r" ON "q2q".raceid = "q2r".raceid WHERE "q2r".year = 2017 AND "q2r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2q".q2) <> '' ORDER BY q2_time ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS "second_time") LIMIT 501

WITH "french_editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".date FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990), "fastest" AS (SELECT "l".raceid, "l".driverid, MIN("l".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" INNER JOIN "french_editions" AS "fe" ON "fe".raceid = "l".raceid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "l".raceid, "l".driverid), "qualifying_over" AS (SELECT "f".raceid, "f".driverid, "f".fastest_ms, "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "fastest" AS "f" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "f".driverid WHERE "f".fastest_ms > 90000) SELECT "fe".date, "qo".forename, "qo".surname, CASE WHEN "qo".fastest_ms IS NOT NULL THEN ("qo".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN ("qo".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (("qo".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN "qo".fastest_ms % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN "qo".fastest_ms % 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ("qo".fastest_ms % 1000)::TEXT END AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" LEFT JOIN "qualifying_over" AS "qo" ON "qo".raceid = "fe".raceid ORDER BY "fe".date ASC, "qo".surname ASC, "qo".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "q2".driverid = "d2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "season_totals" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, "r".year, SUM("cr".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "constructorresults" AS "cr" ON "cr".constructorid = "c".constructorid LEFT JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cr".raceid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, "r".year), "career_totals" AS (SELECT constructorid, name, url, SUM(COALESCE(season_points, 0)) AS "career_points" FROM "season_totals" GROUP BY constructorid, name, url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career_totals") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

WITH "q2_times" AS (SELECT "q".driverid, "q".raceid, "q".q2 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> ''), "ranked" AS (SELECT driverid, raceid, q2, MIN(q2) OVER () AS "fastest_q2" FROM "q2_times") SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "ranked" AS "x" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "x".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "x".raceid WHERE "x".q2 = "x".fastest_q2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "chinese_races" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".year, "r".time, "r".date FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL), "earliest" AS (SELECT * FROM "chinese_races" ORDER BY time::TIME ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1), "winner" AS (SELECT "res".raceid, "res".driverid, "res".milliseconds FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "earliest" AS "e" ON "e".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".position = 1), "runner_up" AS (SELECT "res".raceid, "res".driverid, "res".milliseconds, "res".time FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "earliest" AS "e" ON "e".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "res".position = 2) SELECT "e".year AS "season_year", CASE WHEN "ru".milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND "w".milliseconds IS NOT NULL THEN "ru".milliseconds - "w".milliseconds ELSE NULL END AS "runner_up_gap_milliseconds" FROM "earliest" AS "e" INNER JOIN "winner" AS "w" ON "w".raceid = "e".raceid INNER JOIN "runner_up" AS "ru" ON "ru".raceid = "e".raceid LIMIT 501

WITH "dept_majors" AS (SELECT department, major_id, major_name FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "member_counts" AS (SELECT link_to_major AS "major_id", COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT "dm".department AS "department", STRING_AGG("dm".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "dm".major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", COALESCE(STRING_AGG("dm".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "dm".major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE("mc".member_count, 0) > 0), '') AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("mc".member_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "dept_majors" AS "dm" LEFT JOIN "member_counts" AS "mc" ON "mc".major_id = "dm".major_id GROUP BY "dm".department ORDER BY "dm".department ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "attendance_counts" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id), "budget_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) SELECT "e"."type" AS "event_type", COALESCE(SUM("ac".attended), 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("bt".budgeted), 0) AS "total_budgeted_dollars" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".event_id = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "budget_totals" AS "bt" ON "bt".event_id = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e"."type" ORDER BY "e"."type" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "maj".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "maj" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "maj".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "attendance") AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "maj".college = 'College of Engineering' AND ("m".member_id IS NULL OR "a".link_to_member IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY "maj".department ORDER BY "maj".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category ILIKE 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

WITH "attendee_counts" AS (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event), "water_costs" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendee_counts" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "water_costs" AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".spent > 0 AND "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chip%' AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "b2".budget_id WHERE "b2".spent > 0 AND "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chip%') AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b3".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b3" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x3" ON "x3".link_to_budget = "b3".budget_id WHERE "b3".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b3".spent > 0 AND "x3".expense_description ILIKE '%chip%') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "college_counts" AS (SELECT "major".college, COUNT(*) AS "major_count" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id GROUP BY "major".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, major_count, MAX(major_count) OVER () AS "top_count" FROM "college_counts") SELECT college, major_count FROM "ranked" WHERE major_count = top_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location AS "location", COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 AND "e".location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".location ORDER BY "e".location ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "closed_events" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" WHERE "e".status = 'Closed'), "event_budget" AS (SELECT "ce".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending" FROM "closed_events" AS "ce" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ce".event_id GROUP BY "ce".event_id), "eligible" AS (SELECT "eb".event_id FROM "event_budget" AS "eb" WHERE "eb".total_spending <= "eb".total_budget), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "ex".link_to_budget, COUNT(*) AS "purchase_count" FROM "expense" AS "ex" GROUP BY "ex".link_to_budget), "event_purchases" AS (SELECT "el".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("pc".purchase_count), 0) AS "purchase_count" FROM "eligible" AS "el" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "el".event_id LEFT JOIN "purchase_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "el".event_id) SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event_purchases" AS "ep" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "ep".event_id ORDER BY "ep".purchase_count DESC, "ep".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "attendance_by_type" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type), "ranked" AS (SELECT type, member_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY member_count DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "attendance_by_type") SELECT type, member_count FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' AND "e".expense_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "e".expense_description AS "item_name", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "v" ON "b".link_to_event = "v".event_id WHERE "v".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".category, "e".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".event_date ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "parsed" AS (SELECT link_to_member, cost, CASE WHEN expense_description LIKE 'Water,%' THEN 'Water' WHEN expense_description LIKE 'Bakery - %' THEN 'Bakery' WHEN expense_description LIKE 'Post Cards,%' THEN 'Post Cards' ELSE expense_description END AS "item1", CASE WHEN expense_description LIKE 'Water,%' THEN split_part(expense_description, ', ', 2) END AS "item2", CASE WHEN expense_description LIKE 'Water,%' AND split_part(expense_description, ', ', 3) <> '' THEN split_part(expense_description, ', ', 3) END AS "item3", CASE WHEN expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'muffins' END AS "item_extra" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'), "member_items" AS (SELECT link_to_member, item1 AS "item" FROM "parsed" WHERE item1 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, item2 FROM "parsed" WHERE item2 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, item3 FROM "parsed" WHERE item3 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, item_extra FROM "parsed" WHERE item_extra IS NOT NULL), "counts" AS (SELECT link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS "kind_count" FROM "member_items" GROUP BY link_to_member), "spending" AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY link_to_member), "result" AS (SELECT "c".link_to_member, "c".kind_count, "s".total_spending, MAX("c".kind_count) OVER () AS "max_count" FROM "counts" AS "c" INNER JOIN "spending" AS "s" USING (link_to_member)) SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", "r".kind_count, "r".total_spending FROM "result" AS "r" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "r".link_to_member WHERE "r".kind_count = "r".max_count LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501
