WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA')), "per_patient" AS (SELECT "e".id, CASE WHEN COUNT("l".plt) FILTER (WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "has_normal" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_normal = 1) AS "with_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_normal = 0) AS "never_normal_platelet" FROM "per_patient" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '1000', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 32 GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

WITH "psoriatic_patients" AS (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis'), "lab_counts" AS (SELECT "p".id, COUNT("l".id) AS "lab_count" FROM "psoriatic_patients" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id GROUP BY "p".id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT("l".id) FROM "psoriatic_patients" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "lab_counts" WHERE lab_count = 0) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis > 0 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE "thrombosis" > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_examination_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_examination_date" FROM "examination" WHERE "examination".id = "p".id AND "Examination Date" IS NOT NULL) AS "e" ON TRUE WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e".first_examination_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got IS NOT NULL AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id AS "patient_id", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND (("l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 300) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('>=300', '>=1000')) ORDER BY patient_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_cre_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT * FROM (SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '+' AND "l2"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' AND "l2"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL)) AS "u" ORDER BY CASE WHEN admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "l".rnp AS "anti_rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX("l2".rnp::INTEGER) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') GROUP BY "p".id, "l".rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("l".hct) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(300)', '+3(300)') OR "l"."U-PRO" LIKE '+2(300)%' OR "l"."U-PRO" LIKE '+3(300)%' OR "l"."U-PRO" LIKE '+2(1000)%' OR "l"."U-PRO" LIKE '+3(1000)%') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND ("e".kct IS NULL OR "e".kct <> '+') AND ("e".rvvt IS NULL OR "e".rvvt <> '+') AND ("e".lac IS NULL OR "e".lac <> '+') LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_sample" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, date, sc170 FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT id FROM "latest_sample" WHERE date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".id HAVING BOOL_OR("l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AND BOOL_OR("l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', ''))) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l"."rnp" AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."cre" < 1.5 AND "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "max_value" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp_value) AS "rnp_value" FROM "eligible") SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp_value FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "max_value" AS "m" ON "e".rnp_value = "m".rnp_value INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligibility_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND (("l".fg IS NOT NULL AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450)) OR ("l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR ("l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 300)))) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal_ldh_measurement_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id AND "anemia".hgb < 10 WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "per_patient" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex), "peak" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS "level" FROM "per_patient") SELECT "pp".id, "pp".sex, "pp".highest_rnp FROM "per_patient" AS "pp" CROSS JOIN "peak" WHERE "pp".highest_rnp = "peak".level LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_labs" AS (SELECT id, date, got, rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date ASC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory") SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ranked_labs" WHERE rn = 1 AND got < 60 AND rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, date, "U-PRO" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')), "normal_gpt_max" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "max_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "qualifying_patients" AS "q" ON "q".id = "l".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "normal_gpt_max" AS "m" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "m".id ORDER BY "m".max_gpt DESC, "m".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna <> '' ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, sex FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "T-BIL" >= 1.2) ORDER BY sex ASC, id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "rnp_status" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".care_setting, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".care_setting) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp = 1) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp = 0) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "rnp_status" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "max_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "latest".id AND "l".date = "latest".max_date WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC), "settings" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting", "li".igg FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')) SELECT setting AS "care setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE igg > 900 AND igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" GROUP BY setting ORDER BY setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l"."rnp", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l") SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rn = 1 AND "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "high_ldh" ON "high_ldh".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" = '100' OR "U-PRO" = '300' OR "U-PRO" = '>=300' OR "U-PRO" = '>=1000' OR "U-PRO" = '+2(100)' OR "U-PRO" = '4' OR "U-PRO" = '30' GROUP BY id) AS "protein" ON "protein".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT "p"."diagnosis" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p"."admission" LIKE '+%' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "low_rbc_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5), "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".admission, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INT AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "low_rbc_patients" AS "lr" ON "lr".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-')) SELECT admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(completed_age)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY admission ORDER BY admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "number_of_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_anti_cardiolipin_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND (LOWER("l".rnp) = 'negative' OR "l".rnp = '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "l".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND "n".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "n".rnp <> 'negative' AND "n".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 'FM999999990.0')::NUMERIC AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER >= 64) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type = '-' LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) AS "molecule_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / COUNT(*), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_saturation" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') AS "all_single" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label), "grouped_counts" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN all_single THEN 'all single bonds' ELSE 'not all single bonds' END AS "bond_group", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') AS "carcinogenic_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "non_carcinogenic_count" FROM "molecule_saturation" GROUP BY all_single) SELECT bond_group, carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count AS "count_difference" FROM "grouped_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a1".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "pa".atom_id, "pa".element FROM "plus_atoms" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "pa".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "pa".atom_id), "counts" AS (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_count" FROM "bonded_atoms" GROUP BY element), "winners" AS (SELECT element FROM "counts" WHERE bonded_count = (SELECT MAX(bonded_count) FROM "counts")), "total" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "plus_atoms") SELECT "w".element, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT atom_count FROM "total"), 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "winners" AS "w" INNER JOIN "plus_atoms" AS "pa" ON "pa".element = "w".element GROUP BY "w".element ORDER BY "w".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element <> 'na' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "a".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT "an".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "an" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "an".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "an".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "an".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "chlorine".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

WITH "triple_bond_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#'), "counts" AS (SELECT "m".label, COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM "triple_bond_molecules" AS "t" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "t".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".label), "total" AS (SELECT SUM(molecule_count) AS "n" FROM "counts") SELECT "c".label, ROUND(100.0 * "c".molecule_count / "t".n, 2) AS "percent" FROM "counts" AS "c" CROSS JOIN "total" AS "t" ORDER BY "c".label DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "rare_atom" ON "rare_atom".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1) AS "rare_element" ON "rare_element".element = "rare_atom".element INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "rare_atom".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "rare_atom".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "total_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'c') AS "carbon_atoms", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "total_bonds", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".total_atoms, COALESCE("bc".total_bonds, 0) AS "total_bonds", "ac".carbon_atoms, "ac".chlorine_atoms, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "multiple_bonds", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, "ac".total_atoms DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atoms > 0) SELECT rank, molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, total_atoms, total_bonds, carbon_atoms, chlorine_atoms, carbon_touching_bonds, multiple_bonds FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "b"."bond_id" = "c"."bond_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c"."atom_id" = "a"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" WHERE "a"."element" = 'h' AND "b"."molecule_id" IN (SELECT "molecule_id" FROM "atom" WHERE "element" = 'y') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "per_atom" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element AS "element", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a1".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element) || '|' || GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT atom_id FROM (SELECT "c".atom_id AS "atom_id", "b".bond_type AS "bond_type" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id UNION ALL SELECT "c".atom_id2 AS "atom_id", "b".bond_type AS "bond_type" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id) AS "endpoints" GROUP BY atom_id HAVING BOOL_AND(bond_type = '-')) AS "saturated" ON "saturated".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element <> 'na' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
